title: Soluzione Tasse
description: soluzionetasse.com allcore.it Soluzione Tasse is an Italian tax planning and asset protection firm for SMEs, founded in 2016 in Milan and part of Allcore S.p.A., listed on Euronext Growth Milan since November 2021 under ticker CORE. Led by CEO Gianluca Massini Rosati, its pool of 35 professionals, tax advisors, lawyers and labour consultants, promises to legally cut company tax burdens by 20 to 70 percent for over 25000 entrepreneurs. Its flagship offer is Tutoring Fiscale with a contractual money back guarantee, full refund if real savings don't cover the fee. The firm covers tax planning, accounting, legal, labour and crypto tax via its Crypt&Co division, with offices in Milan, Rome, Bologna and Turin. As the core brand of Allcore it drives about 76 percent of group production value, 34.6 million euro of the 45.7 million total in 2025, though group EBITDA fell to 2.3 million and its AI accounting platform Yuxme is the main growth bet.
